resolution.summary: Fixed 3 bugs: (1) M1 MFHI/MFLO/MTHI/MTLO rega_sel used M1 sub-function code instead of actual register from bits[3:0], (2) loadLower/loadUpper in writeback used stale pipeline-captured values instead of live reghi/reglo, (3) disassembler showed wrong register for M1 register ops. Also fixed test_hilo.asm NOP timing and AIS test expectations.
